primary_interest.quote: Right, that's what you flagged. Can you walk me through what you're trying to do with SMS notifications?

use_case.quote: Alerts, confirmations, that kind of thing. Customers get a text when something happens on their account.

decision_criteria.quote: Reliability, mostly. If notifications don't go out, that's a problem for us, it's financial, people notice.

stated_reason.quote: we'd prefer to keep things with our existing cloud and AI vendor if we can. Fewer contracts, fewer moving parts.
